none: PAS KENT-F41235: Denarius of Hadrian. Reverse view.
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete, Roman, struck or hammered, silver denarius of Hadrian (117-138AD). Obverse: Laureate bust right, draped and cuirassed. Inscription: [IMP] CAES.TRAIAN.HADRIAN.AVG [DIVITRA]. Reverse: Fortuna seated holding a rudder but no globe with 'Fortred' in the exergue. Inscription: PM[]TRPCOS. Die axis: 6 o'clock. The coin is in very fine condition with little wear. It has an attractive silver colour with just one spot of dark green verdigris on the obverse and the reverse has a slight weak grey tarnish. This coin dates to 117AD following Trajan's death. Ref.
